title: undergroundbiomes
description: The mod adds 23 stone variants from the original undergroundbiomes mod.
body:
![Overview of the stone types](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66c9df521c7055456fa7e68a4ceecaa082a4beb7_0.webp)

It is no coincidence that is mod is named like the former version that existed for Minecraft 1.12 and before.

This mod adds the 23 original stone types to Minecraft. Each stone type is located in a different biome.
All stones can be treated like the vanilla stone.

The crafting recipes match the recipes for vanilla stones.

All the stones exist in the following variants
- stone
- cobblestone
- stone bricks
- stairs
- slabs
- pressure plates
- buttons
- walls
- smooth stone
